description: The City of Calgary produced this open dataset of water main breaks, with the location of each break and a break type code (full circular, split, corrosion, fitting, joint, diagonal crack, hole, saddle). The city notes that breaks happen year-round, with pipe age, pipe material, soil conditions and temperature among the contributing factors. Coverage is the City of Calgary. The data are free under the Open Calgary Open Data Terms on the city's open data portal. Caveats: the page does not give the period covered, and pipe attributes are not listed among the fields. Simulation uses: break histories by failure mode for pipe failure models and network resilience. Related records: Toronto's watermain breaks (data-toronto-watermain-breaks).
